provision.text: This MARADMIN is the promotion authority for all lance corporals (LCpls) and corporals (Cpls) of the active duty Marine Corps. Cutting scores are available in the Marine Corps Total Force System (MCTFS) after the current month select grades post. Prior to effecting promotions, commands are reminded of their requirement to verify each select grade Marineâ€™s JEPES promotion score meets or exceeds the published cutting score. Retain the current month cutting scores with this MARADMIN for future reference.

For additional details regarding requirements related to viewing cutoff scores in MCTFS, time in grade, time in service, professional military education, commander responsibilities, and the junior enlisted remedial process, visit the Enlisted Promotions website at https://www.manpower.marines.mil, click on â€œDivisionsâ€ / â€œManpower Managementâ€ / â€œPerformance Branchâ€ / â€œPromotion Sectionâ€ / â€œEnlisted Promotionsâ€ / â€œSergeants and Below Promotions.â€
References (a) and (b) set forth guidance and instructions for effecting monthly promotions of LCpls and Cpls who meet the following criteria:
The command cutoff for 1 July 2026 promotions is 31 May 2026. Entries with a date after 31 May 2026 will not count towards a 1 July 2026 promotion score.
For Marine enlisted promotion matters, e-mail inquiries to [contact withheld].
Release authorized by MajGen Fridrik Fridriksson, Director, Manpower Management Division.//

correction.change: normalize_identifiers.py - period replaced with underscore in every USLM path segment
the period is reserved in USLM for the manifestation suffix, so a segment such as mco/1050.3j is ambiguous against the published grammar
underscore is drawn from the RFC 3986 unreserved set, which the USLM 2.1 Review Guide already requires for version strings
document id, native number, and displayed text are unchanged
